module: Provides the data displayed by the photo mode "radar / speed camera" overlay: current map, place name, level time, player vehicle license plate, speed limit of the nearest road and position. Everything is read-only with protected accesses (pcall): no value is modified.
usage:
local d = ui_photomode_speedCameraOverlay.getData()
print(d.mapName, d.locationName, d.speedLimit, d.licensePlate)
notes: The position comes from player vehicle 0, otherwise from the camera (core_camera.getPosition or getPositionXYZ).
The limit comes from the road graph (map.findClosestRoad within a 120 m radius); it is nil if <= 0, infinite or > 200 (graph edge unit, m/s according to the road graph code — not verified here).
Texts (level title, zone name) go through _tr if it exists.

getData.desc: Builds the overlay's data table. Missing strings are "", levelTime is {} if the time is unavailable, roadDistance/speedLimit/position are nil if unknown.

returns.desc: {mapId=string, mapName=string, locationName=string (highest-priority gameplay_city zone, otherwise mapName), levelTime={time,year,month,day} from core_environment.getTimeOfDay, licensePlate=string, roadDistance=number|nil (distance to the nearest road), speedLimit=number|nil, position={x,y,z}|nil}.
